# VN Club

> The site for people serious about Japanese visual novels: a full VNDB-derived catalogue, statistics and rankings, a reading club, and free guides for reading them in the original Japanese.

VN Club is a site about Japanese visual novels, for readers who read them in Japanese. It provides step-by-step guides for text hooking, popup dictionaries, Anki mining, and other tools needed to read Japanese VNs. The site also features a VNDB browser, personalized recommendations, a kana quiz, and aggregated VN news.

The philosophy is immersion-first: read the original Japanese text from the start, using tools to assist comprehension rather than relying on translations.

## Guides

- [All Guides](https://vnclub.figamin.net/guides/): Index of every guide on the site, grouped by what it sets up: getting the text out of the game, dictionaries and vocabulary, running visual novels anywhere, picture quality, and finding and tracking.
- [Learning Japanese with Visual Novels](https://vnclub.figamin.net/guide/): Complete beginner's guide covering kana, Textractor, JL dictionary, Anki mining, and immersion strategies for reading VNs in Japanese.
- [FAQ](https://vnclub.figamin.net/faq/): Frequently asked questions about learning Japanese with visual novels, covering costs, progress, difficulty, dictionaries, and reading philosophy.
- [Textractor Setup Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/textractor-guide/): Text hooking setup for extracting Japanese text from visual novels with WebSocket extension and regex patterns.
- [JL Setup Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/jl-guide/): Popup dictionary with Anki mining, pitch accents, and frequency display for reading Japanese VNs.
- [Yomitan Setup Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/yomitan-guide/): Browser popup dictionary for instant Japanese lookups and Anki mining while reading visual novels.
- [Anki Setup Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/anki-guide/): FSRS scheduling, recommended settings, add-ons, and best practices for Japanese vocabulary retention.
- [Useful Tools](https://vnclub.figamin.net/tools/): Essential tools and utilities to enhance the visual novel reading experience.
- [VN Recommendations & Discovery](https://vnclub.figamin.net/find/): Find visual novels for your Japanese level with difficulty ratings and community recommendations.
- [Where to Get Japanese VNs](https://vnclub.figamin.net/sources/): Guide to buying and downloading untranslated Japanese visual novels from DLsite, DMM, and other sources.

## Tool Guides

- [Agent Text Hooker](https://vnclub.figamin.net/agent-guide/): Script-based text extraction for games where standard text hookers fail.
- [OwOCR Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/owocr-guide/): OCR for extracting Japanese text from images, untexthookable VNs, and console games.
- [Meikipop Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/meikipop-guide/): OCR popup dictionary for instant lookups on any on-screen Japanese text.
- [Bottles Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/bottles-guide/): Running Japanese visual novels on Linux using Wine prefixes with Textractor support.
- [GameHub Lite Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/gamehub-lite-guide/): Running Windows visual novels on Android devices.
- [Kirikiroid2 Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/kirikiroid-guide/): Playing Kirikiri engine visual novels natively on Android.
- [Neko Project II Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/np2-guide/): PC-98 visual novel emulation with text hooking for Japanese learning.
- [Magpie Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/magpie-guide/): Window upscaling for low-resolution VNs using Anime4K, FSR, and CRT shaders.
- [ShaderGlass Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/shaderglass-guide/): Transparent overlay for CRT shaders, upscaling, and retro effects on VNs.
- [JDownloader Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/jdownloader-guide/): Downloading visual novels from DDL sites with split archive support.
- [VNTimeTracker Guide](https://vnclub.figamin.net/timetracker-guide/): Tracking visual novel reading time and learning statistics.

## Features

- [Browse VNs](https://vnclub.figamin.net/browse/): Search and filter VNDB's visual novel database with difficulty ratings and detailed info.
- [VN Recommendations](https://vnclub.figamin.net/recommendations/): Personalized visual novel recommendations based on your preferences and reading level.
- [Upcoming Releases](https://vnclub.figamin.net/news/upcoming/): Japanese visual novels with a release date still ahead, grouped by month.
- [Stats & Rankings](https://vnclub.figamin.net/stats/): Visual novel statistics: staff, producers, tags, traits, seiyuu, and rankings.
- [VN News](https://vnclub.figamin.net/news/all/): Aggregated Japanese visual novel news from VNDB, Twitter, and RSS feeds.
- [Kana Quiz](https://vnclub.figamin.net/quiz/): Hiragana and katakana recognition practice with a running streak.
- [Word of the Day](https://vnclub.figamin.net/word-of-the-day/): A Japanese word a day, with readings, pitch accent, conjugations, and example sentences taken from visual novels.

## Community

- [Join Discord](https://vnclub.figamin.net/join/): VN Club Resurrection community for Japanese learners reading visual novels.
- [Past Club Picks](https://vnclub.figamin.net/events/history/): Everything the club has picked together, newest first: the monthly and seasonal visual novels, the weekly read-aloud and Movie Night.
